quickref.name: Haunted Castle
quickref.era: BBR v1.3.3 Halloween update (wiki date Oct 10, 2012) [Game text via wiki]; removed around the BBR-to-BBG switch in 2013 (wiki says 'v2.0') [Fan-wiki]; returned in BBG 2.4, Oct 24, 2013: 'To celebrate the holiday, the Haunted Castle map has made a return!' [Canon]; fan video titles place it in play at Halloween 2015 and Oct-Nov 2021 [Unverified]
quickref.in_2026: Not named on the Steam store page [Canon, by absence]. Its music ('Haunted Castle', 1:01, track 11) is on the official BBG Soundtrack releasing Nov 4, 2026 [Canon]. A fan video titled 'BATTLE BEARS GOLD Is Actually Back… (Haunted Castle FFA)' from early Oct 2026 hints it was in a playtest [Unverified]. Launch rotation status unknown.
quickref.setting: A Halloween castle at night: a square slate-blue curtain-walled castle with a tall central tower on four legs, set among graveyard lawns where both teams spawn; underground tunnels link the bases to the courtyard [Observed; Fan-wiki for tunnels]
quickref.palette_and_lighting: Night; near-black violet starry sky #110012 with a purple-magenta horizon glow and dark hills. Cool slate-blue stone #1B3541-#2A2F45. Warm torch-lit terracotta courtyard #B5503D (shadow #3F282B). Dark lawns #162D1E with rust leaves. Violet-lit headstones #47448F. Red team banners #660302-#730810 and blue #0A01C9. Pumpkins #C65A01 with yellow-orange glow, crates #743C1F, iron #1C2124, torch flame #E74908. Promo art only: pink jack-o'-lantern moon #FDC2FD and a magenta wash [Observed]
quickref.landmarks: Central tower on four legs with plank walkways and a glowing jump pad under its arch; team gatehouses with black portcullis and red or blue bear-emblem banners, with the gate switch above; memorial name slab beside an R.I.P. stone in each spawn graveyard; crenellated wall with round corner towers and torches; terracotta courtyard with crate and jack-o'-lantern piles and corner pits; lawns with coffins, iron railing, tall hedges and a cave mound into the tunnels
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: Melee-toggled switches open and close gates in the tunnels; jump pads; two Bearscream Sandwiches at opposite ends; hidden outer ledge to a jagged hole into the courtyard (needs SW Boots or Jump) [Fan-wiki]. Gravestone names MK, Lt. Action, Rob, Trang, An, Jackson, Grimes, 1nachoboy5, Apothecy [Observed; Fan-wiki]. No damage hazards documented.

corrections.current_text: [FAN-WIKI] The wiki lists 15 BBG maps across the original run, and Haunted Castle and Desert Airmine were removed at 2.0 and Haunted Castle later returned
corrections.correction: Relabel the return as [OFFICIAL] and quote it: SkyVu's BBG 2.4 notes (24 Oct 2013) say "Haunted Castle Returns / To celebrate the holiday, the Haunted Castle map has made a return!". Mark "removed at 2.0" as the wiki's uncertain label. Add that Haunted Castle debuted in Battle Bears Royale v1.3.3 (dated Oct 10, 2012 in the wiki's update table), before the BBG name.
corrections.evidence: Archived official post https://web.archive.org/web/20131101183026/http://battlebears.com/battle-bears-gold-update-2-4-now-available-release-notes/ (saved copy at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/saberi/official/prior/u24.html.txt). A July 2013 revision of the wiki page (rev 45817) said "As of version 2.1". The wiki's Updates and BBG Versions tables go from BBG 1.0 (May 24, 2013) to 2.1 (July 15, 2013) with no 2.0. The wiki's Updates table lists BBR 1.3.3 ">NEW Haunted Castle map with interactive features!" dated October 10, 2012.

corrections.current_text: **Haunted Castle**: an Addams Family parody ("The Battle Bears Family. Their house is a haunted castle.").
corrections.correction: Tag "an Addams Family parody" as [INFERENCE], our reading and not SkyVu's words. Mark the quote as not re-verified (Wayback was down on 2016-10-16) until the archived page is re-read.
corrections.evidence: Repeated fetches of https://web.archive.org/web/20140507064142/http://battlebears.com/games/battle-bears-royale/maps/haunted-castle/ failed with connection resets and HTTP 429; archive.ph showed a CAPTCHA. The note's own quote does not contain the word "Addams".

corrections.current_text: He shares a tombstone with Jackson on BBG's Haunted Castle map.
corrections.correction: His name is engraved, with Jackson's and seven others (MK, Lt. Action, Rob, Trang, An, 1nachoboy5, Apothecy), on a memorial slab in Haunted Castle's graveyard. The wiki says there are two identical slabs, one in each spawn. This is [OBSERVED] in wiki-hosted gameplay screenshots. The map debuted in Battle Bears Royale v1.3.3 (Oct 2012) and returned in BBG 2.4 (Oct 2013).
corrections.evidence: File:Grimes Dead??.jpg and File:Haunted_Castle_Gravestone.png (opened at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/maps/dl/haunted_castle/orig/Grimes_Dead.jpg and .../orig/Haunted_Castle_Gravestone.png) show the slab's three columns: MK / Lt. Action / Jackson; Rob / Trang / An; Grimes / 1nachoboy5 / Apothecy. The wiki's Haunted Castle Trivia says "two identical gravestones (one in each spawn)".
